title: Line up which digits?
text: Add decimals by lining up the decimal points, which lines up equal places. $$2.5$$ is $$2.50$$ if you want both numbers to show hundredths. A common mistake is to line up the last digits and add 5 to 5, as if 2.5 were 2.50 shifted. What is $$50 + 75$$ hundredths? Give the number of hundredths.

title: Carry the extra ten hundredths
text: 125 hundredths is 1 one and 25 hundredths. Add that 1 to the ones place, which already has $$2 + 1 = 3$$. What is $$3 + 1$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$2.50 + 1.75 = 4.25$$. Common mistake: answering $$3.80$$ or $$2.125$$ by misaligning the places. General rule: line up the decimal points, add each place, and carry ten of a place into one of the next place to the left.
